page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable, text-only review rules. Link them to agents — enabled skills are appended to the agent's prompt in order.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a markdown file or a skill archive.

card.importedTitle: Imported from a third party — wrapped as untrusted in the prompt
card.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {not linked} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
card.toggleLabel: Enable skill for all linked agents

preview.disabled: Disabled — not added to any agent's prompt
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill was imported. Someone else's skill is someone else's instructions in your agent's prompt: it is wrapped as untrusted data and may only add review criteria — it cannot change the agent's role, output or severity rules.
preview.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It will be unlinked from every agent.

editor.subtitle: A skill is plain text appended to an agent's prompt. It cannot run code or use tools.
editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: kebab-case identifier, shown in the prompt and the agent's Skills tab.
editor.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — write it as a directive: when to apply it and what it flags. E.g. "Use on every PR that touches routes. Flag removed or renamed response fields."
editor.bodyHint: The rules the reviewer applies. Saving a changed body creates a new version.
editor.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what to check and at which severity…

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a markdown file or a skill archive (.zip with SKILL.md). Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.trustTitle: You are adding someone else's instructions to your agents
import.trustBody: An imported skill goes into the agent's prompt as untrusted text. Read the body below before saving. Scripts and binaries from archives are never run — they are listed as ignored.
import.saved: Imported "{name}" — link it to an agent in the agent's Skills tab.
